notes: Input file: the brief named 003.json, but the batch for this agent is 03.json (15 groups, all ids confirmed in the wave ids list). Searches: 2 of 2 used. Searches went to Friends of Orianna Hill Park (no website) and Germantown Conservancy (dead domain). Friends of Orkney Park has a dead domain and got no search, so it is unknown. Five records are unknown (publish, low confidence) with no summary, so they are held back: Orianna Hill, Orkney Park, Germantown Conservancy, Girard Garden, and the Historical Society of the Eastern District federal court. Girard Garden and the Historical Society render no readable text, so they need a manual look or a page that renders scripts. Hannah Callowhill Stage is a podcast blog about a building dig, so not_a_group. Historians of British Art is a national society with no Philadelphia presence on its site, so out_of_area. Friends of the South Street Police Mini-Station: newest explicit dated item is October 2024, on the 24 month edge. Name and address differences from the IRS list are recorded in each record's notes. Budget: 20 fetches used of 60; no rate limiting seen. Not done: Germantown Conservancy www variant, and contact pages for Global Water Alliance and Historians of British Art.
